data.name: Cyrillus
data.gender_notes: Cyrillus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'kyrios', meaning 'lord', 'master', or 'ruler'. In Christian tradition, Cyrillus was a bishop who played a significant role in spreading Christianity in Bulgaria and Slavia. He is revered as a saint in both the Roman Catholic and Eastern Orthodox Churches. The name Cyrillus carries the meaning “Having power, rule, or authority” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Cyrillus usually hope their child will grow to embody having power, rule, or authority and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual authority and leadership in one's community.
data.etymology: Cyrillus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Having power, rule, or authority.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cyrillus total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.meaning: אדון האדונים, אדון ה' הוא האדון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קירילוס מקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'אדון האדונים' או 'אדון ה' הוא האדון'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'קיריוס' שפירושה 'אדון' או 'הוא האדון'. השם קירילוס היה נפוץ בכנסייה הנוצרית הקדומה והיה שמו של מספר קדושים ורועים רוחניים.

in_greek.name: Κύριλλος
in_greek.meaning: Κύριος, ο Κύριος είναι ο Θεός
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κύριλλος προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'Κύριος' που σημαίνει 'Κύριος' ή 'ο Κύριος είναι ο Θεός'. Το όνομα Κύριλλος ήταν κοινό στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία Χριστιανική και ήταν το όνομα πολλών αγίων και ποιμένων.

in_latin.name: Cyrillus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Cyrillus derivatur a verbo Graeco 'Κύριος' quod significat 'Dominus' vel 'Deus Dominus'. Nomen Cyrillus in Ecclesia Christiana primitiva frequenter occurrebat et nomen erat plurium sanctorum et pastorium.

in_english.name: Cyrillus
in_english.meaning: Lord, Master, or God is Lord
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cyrillus originates from the Greek word 'Κύριος' (Kyrios), meaning 'Lord' or 'Master'. It is derived from the Hebrew concept of 'Adonai,' signifying God's sovereignty. Cyrillus has been used in Christian tradition to denote a person devoted to God or a saint who embodies lordship over spiritual realms. Historically, several saints bore this name, contributing to its spiritual significance in Christian cultures.

data.cultural_impact: Cyrillus is an important figure in the history of Christianity in Bulgaria and Eastern Europe. He is best known for his missionary work in promoting Christianity among the Slavic peoples, which included translating religious texts into the Old Church Slavonic language, thereby enabling the widespread adoption of Christianity in this region. His contributions have had a lasting impact on the linguistic and cultural development of Eastern Europe.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, Cyrillus is a beloved saint and revered for his deep spiritual commitment to spreading the Word of God among the Slavic peoples. His work in translating religious texts into Old Church Slavonic allowed the faithful to access the Bible in their native language, enabling them to gain a deeper understanding and connection to their faith. Cyrillus' legacy as a patron of education, culture, and spiritual growth has made him a beloved figure in Eastern European Christian tradition.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cyrillus signifies the 'tender one', a name rooted in the Greek word 'kyrion', meaning 'lord' or 'master'. This moniker highlights the gentle, loving, and caring aspects of the Christian faith. It is a reminder to be compassionate and nurturing towards others, reflecting the teachings and essence of Christ.

historical_references.context: The name is associated with two historical figures: one a patriarch of Alexandria, the other a monk and theologian.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Cyrillus remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Thomas Cyrillus from Rome, Italy embodies the meaning of Cyrillus - "Having power, rule, or authority". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
